description: Conversion of roof space to habitable use with a rear dormer and front roof lights. Removal of 2no. chimney breasts.
decision_conditions: Due to its size, design and location within a part of the Conservation Area absent of similar forms of development, the proposed hip to gable roof extension and dormer would form an uncharacteristic and incongruous addition to the Conservation Area, subsequently causing less than substantial harm to its significance. Harm which has not been outweighed by public benefits. Furthermore, the development would form an oversized and over-dominant addition to the host dwelling which would fail to harmonise with its architectural composition, subsequently harming its appearance and character. The proposal would therefore be contrary to Policies BE1 and HE1 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part One - Strategic Policies (November 2012), Policies DMHB 1, and DMHB 4 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part Two, Development Management Policies (2020), Policy HC1 of the London Plan (2021) and paragraphs 135, 210 and 215 of the NPPF (2024).

The decision to REFUSE planning permission has been taken having regard to all relevant planning legislation, regulations, guidance, circulars and Council policies, including The Human Rights Act (1998) (HRA 1998) which makes it unlawful for the Council to act incompatibly with Convention rights, specifically Article 6 (right to a fair hearing); Article 8 (right to respect for private and family life); Article 1 of the First Protocol (protection of property) and Article 14 (prohibition of discrimination).

The decision to REFUSE planning permission has been taken having regard to the policies and proposals in the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 1 (2012) and Part 2 (2020) set out below, including Supplementary Planning Guidance, and to all relevant material considerations, including The London Plan (2021) and national guidance.
